evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitized runtime forensics within two hours are unavailable.
No per-strategy, per-chain capital-weighted realized NET P&L series after every fee, slippage, price-impact, gas/priority/tip, rent, platform-fee, and failure cost.
No durable outcome taxonomy separating STRATEGY/MARKET loss from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure with ambiguous-case policy.
No quote-to-fill and quote-to-exit deterioration distributions by chain, venue, strategy, notional, liquidity, and congestion regime.
No paid-failure ledger for EVM reverts/timeouts/replacements or Solana landed-invalid, RPC, Jupiter, congestion, and exit failures.
No out-of-sample chronology, drawdown, exposure time, capital utilization, confidence intervals, or regime stability evidence.
No proof that Solana shadow economics reconcile to wallet deltas including priority fees, tips, platform fees, and refundable rent.
No proof that EVM retained net includes actual cycle gas plus approvals, failed transactions, replacements, and profit-fee settlement gas.

Before promotion, provide immutable receipt/signature-linked outcomes, chain-specific cost decomposition, failure classification, money-weighted NET P&L, drawdown, sample independence, and positive out-of-sample confidence bounds.

proposals.downside_risk: Stricter attribution will reduce apparent samples and may leave strategies unpromoted for longer; classification rules can also mislabel ambiguous failures.

evidence.detail: record_window accepts an overriding net_profit; derived net subtracts only fees and slippage, while profit_factor uses gross_profit/gross_loss before costs.

execution_failures is only an aggregate count; evaluate_strategy can emit PROMOTION_CANDIDATE from aggregate net and gross profit factor without money weighting, failure cost, or out-of-sample enforcement.
Shadow quote results are correctly marked non-promotional, but event rows lack gas/priority fees, price-impact cost, failure taxonomy, and realized outcome fields.

proposals.expected_effect: Produce auditable capital-weighted and time-windowed NET P&L after all costs, with attribution that identifies whether edge or delivery failed.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 calendar days, 10 independent windows per chain, 100 eligible observations and 30 realized or faithfully replayed outcomes per strategy/chain, including at least 10 paid or blocked execution failures where available; report money-weighted NET P&L, drawdown, cost decomposition, and bootstrap uncertainty.
proposals.rationale: A negative completed trade after correct execution is a STRATEGY/MARKET loss. Reverts, timeouts, stale quotes, RPC/build failures, invalid landed output, and failed exits are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures; their paid gas, priority fees, tips, and opportunity/exit costs still reduce NET P&L. Promotion decisions must preserve this distinction while charging both categories to economic performance.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay immutable SHADOW observations through a cost ledger containing notional, gross markout, venue/platform fees, slippage, price impact, gas or Solana base/priority/Jito fees, refundable rent, failure cost, and outcome class. Stop and fail the test if recomputed net differs from wallet/receipt deltas beyond rounding tolerance, any paid failure has zero cost, any outcome lacks exactly one STRATEGY_MARKET or EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE class, or promotion changes when caller-supplied net is falsified.

proposals.downside_risk: Sparse qualifying signals may require a long observation period; shadow fills may understate adversarial ordering and congestion.

evidence.detail: Solana applies signal-age, entry-deterioration, round-trip-loss, fee-ratio, slippage/impact, and immediate leader-exit controls.
Receipt schema captures base/priority/Jito/platform fees, rent, wallet delta, price impact, slippage, route hops, and net execution P&L.
Leader median-return and copied-result gates exist, but historical leader performance is not proof that follower timing remains net-positive.

proposals.expected_effect: Determine whether follower-specific executable edge survives quote deterioration, priority fees, platform fees, rent timing, failed exits, and copied-signal latency.
proposals.minimum_observation: 30 days, at least 50 eligible signals from at least 5 independent leaders, 30 complete entry-to-exit outcomes, and representation across normal and congested fee regimes.
proposals.rationale: The controls address Solana-specific execution economics, but leader-copy latency and exit blockage can turn leader alpha into follower STRATEGY/MARKET loss. RPC, Jupiter, congestion, simulation, landed-invalid-output, and account-close problems must be separately measured as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
proposals.shadow_test: For every eligible copied signal, snapshot leader price, follower entry/exit quotes, quote ages, round-trip impact, all Solana fees/tips, rent paid/reclaimed, and simulated wallet delta. Mark market moves after a valid fill as STRATEGY_MARKET and quote/RPC/simulation/landing/exit-delivery failures as EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE. Fail if money-weighted follower net after all costs is non-positive, the lower 95% confidence bound is not positive, execution failures exceed 5% of eligible attempts, or any full exit cannot demonstrate sellability and reconciled proceeds.

proposals.downside_risk: Shadow eth_call cannot fully reproduce mempool competition or inclusion latency, so results may remain optimistic.

evidence.detail: V2/V3 cycle execution repeats wallet-specific simulation, reserves gas at current fee fields, embeds a minimum output covering capital, gas, and minimum net, and performs mandatory pre-broadcast eth_call.
Selection requires a gas-multiple floor and records receipt-confirmed wrapped-balance change minus actual cycle gas.
Rejected or timed-out broadcasts do not record realized failure gas, and expected_net_base excludes scanner slippage reserve and downstream profit-fee settlement cost.

proposals.expected_effect: Measure whether quoted atomic edge survives actual gas, priority fees, state drift, failures, and platform-fee settlement across EVM chains.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 days and 100 candidates per enabled EVM chain, including 30 executable simulations and at least 20 receipt-backed or block-faithful replays per chain across low and high gas regimes.
proposals.rationale: Atomicity limits market exposure, but EVM profitability remains sensitive to base-fee movement, priority bidding, state contention, reverts, nonce/replacement behavior, approvals, and fee-settlement transactions. A valid reverted transaction is an EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss, while an atomically successful but economically negative receipt is a STRATEGY/MARKET/modeling loss.
proposals.shadow_test: Record decision-time quote, exact preflight, block/inclusion delay, simulated and actual gas fields, receipt status, wrapped-token delta, approvals, profit-share settlement cost, and reverted-transaction gas. Fail if any executable candidate lacks positive retained net after all costs, realized/replayed money-weighted net is non-positive, lower 95% confidence bound is not positive, paid failure rate exceeds 2%, or quote-to-inclusion deterioration consumes more than 50% of predicted edge at the 90th percentile.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote strategies from current Strategy Lab thresholds or quote-simulation win counts.
rejected_ideas.reason: Aggregate net and raw wins do not establish durable money-weighted NET P&L, and quote simulations are explicitly non-promotional.

rejected_ideas.idea: Loosen sellability, liquidity, simulation, fee, or positive-edge gates to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: Frequency without positive executable edge increases adverse selection and failure costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all failed or blocked trades as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: This conceals EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE defects and prevents correct remediation, although paid failure costs must remain included in total NET P&L.

summary: Architecture-only review completed and selected tests passed. Execution protections generally fail closed and use chain-specific controls, but promotion accounting is not yet sufficient for durable money-weighted NET P&L. Strategy Lab permits caller-supplied net profit, calculates profit factor from pre-cost gains/losses, and counts execution failures without their economic cost or a durable STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE classification. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness conclusion is possible without fresh runtime forensics.
